title: Vitamux lab report extraction v1
description: Output of a lab-report extractor (docs/architecture/lab-documents.md#extracted-row-schema-v1): a verbatim transcription of what is printed, nothing inferred. Every key is required; null means not printed or unreadable. Only additive, optional changes within v1.

synthetic.description: true only in generated fixtures; extractors omit it.

document.description: Header fields printed once for the whole report. Patient identifiers are never transcribed.

page_count.description: Number of pages in the document.

rows.description: One entry per printed result line, in reading order.

row_index.description: 0-based position of this row in rows.

analyte_label.description: Test name exactly as printed, including any method or specimen words.

value_text.description: Result cell exactly as printed, e.g. '5,2', '< 0.3', 'Negative', '1:160'.

value_numeric.description: The number in value_text with '.' as decimal separator and no comparator; null when value_text has no single number.

comparator.description: Comparator printed in value_text; a printed '≤' or '≥' becomes '<=' or '>='.

unit_text.description: Unit exactly as printed; null when none is printed.

ref_low.description: Lower bound printed in reference_range_text, if any.

ref_high.description: Upper bound printed in reference_range_text, if any.

printed_flag.description: Flag symbol or word printed beside the result, copied verbatim (e.g. 'H', 'L', '*'); null when none is printed.

evidence_text.description: The printed text of the row, verbatim, cells separated by single spaces.

bbox.description: Row area on the page as fractions of page width and height, origin top left.

confidence.description: Transcription certainty from 0 to 1. A hint only.

warnings.description: Transcription problems in this row. A field named by an unreadable_* warning is null.

local_datetime.description: Printed date (and time) as ISO 8601 local time without offset. On rows: the value printed for that row, otherwise the document value.

date_text.description: The same date exactly as printed.
